pp:n5:416.problem: Solvable by shape. The key うちを出る is the only one of the four options carrying 出, the kanji the learner already sees in the target 出かける, so the item can be answered without knowing the word. Under SudachiPy mode A the stem's 出かける decomposes to 出 (dictionary form 出る) plus かける, so the key also shares a word with the stem and no distractor does. The corrected row swaps ごはんをつくる for お金を出す, which puts 出 on a second option and removes the visual giveaway; the residual 出かける / 出る morpheme overlap is intrinsic to this target-key pair and cannot be removed without giving up the precise key. Everything else holds: 「うちを出る前に食べなくてはならない。」 is natural and means the same, the three distractors are clearly different actions, and stem plus every option are level-clean.

corrected.explanation: 出かける é deixar a casa para ir a algum lugar, o mesmo movimento que うちを出る descreve.
